cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a hangar maintenance bay — holds her keepsake at chest height; a vine-covered observation ruin above a luminous alien jungle — she releases a palm-sized survey drone to map a path toward the sunset; a quiet orbital board-game cafe beneath a panoramic cloud deck — she plays the gracious casino host; an underwater palace hall behind great glass arches — holds a small hand lantern low at her side; the long stone stairway of Baidicheng above the Yangtze gorge — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — standing; a starship galley and mess hall — holds a bowl of hot food at chest height; a bath-house changing room of wooden lockers — perched on a ledge or edge; her quiet room beside a large home aquarium of green water plants — holds a book closed against her chest; a steaming outdoor hot spring among rocks and bamboo — holds a small hand lantern low at her side; an editorial photo studio with a seamless backdrop and dramatic lights — kneeling on one knee; an old brush-and-ink shop in a heritage quarter — standing; a sewing and alteration room with a cutting table — pins a freshly washed sheet to the line above her
